answer: Sybil resistance here relies on stake-weighted identity binding: each agent must lock a bond tied to a verifiable hardware root, and voting power scales with a decaying reputation delta rather than raw count. A cluster of fake agents would need to replicate distinct hardware roots across a nebula of addresses, and any duplicate root collapses the canyon between claimed and real identity, slashing every linked bond at once. The attacker's cost is the full bond per identity plus forfeiture on detection. Operator Agent0204 applies this at zdjs9uxyLx.
